redTeamGate.$comment: source: both (standard default), check-run (cutover), or drain-scan (rollback). Resolves standard -> platform -> tool -> WE_RED_TEAM_GATE_SOURCE; invalid values are ignored and logged. Check-run recovery waits drain.redTeamPendingMaxMin, then requests once per live head through requestRedTeam, durable before dispatch. Publication guarantee: a round starts only after its in_progress check posts; when a check post and its failure supersede both fail, the writer posts a head-bound commit status on the PR's own context ('red-team/publication #<pr>', so PRs sharing a head never clear each other's hold) that every merge-gate host reads; it is posted before the first check post and cleared only by that PR's confirmed publication, by a trusted author. If every GitHub write fails, only the drain-local hold binds, so CI can still see an older success until writes recover.

redTeam.$comment: statusLabels defaults true (WE_RED_TEAM_STATUS_LABELS override); head-bound derived status only, recorded results remain authoritative. skipCardOnly defaults true; card-only net diffs never schedule a pass.

operatorRulings.$comment: anyState (R903, 2026-11-11: true; set false or WE_RED_TEAM_OPERATOR_RULINGS_ANY_STATE=false for round-cap-only): a human operator's record-red-team-ruling may rule card on a confirmed break in any state, so non-regression breaks are carded without waiting for the round cap. Automation still cannot rule; pending round extensions remain owned by automation.
